claims.gist: Agentic AI will own bounded end-to-end production tasks in 2027
Start agent deployments with two or three low-error-cost, high-volume workflows
Policies written in 2024 are not enough for hundreds of AI use cases
Non-human identities outnumber human identities in most enterprises, often 40 to 1
Inference costs are now a significant and unpredictable line item
Harvested data can be decrypted later, so post-quantum migration should start now
Block known-malicious packages at install time, not only at scan time
Internal developer platforms are becoming the default way large organizations deliver infrastructure

thesis: The 2027 focus shifts from AI pilots to running, securing and paying for AI; eight trends each come with actions.
